Subject: Silverpine pilot - oneoff credit + 30-day extension ask

Team,

Quick context: Silverpine AI (NDA in; pilot live since 3/10) has shown a heavier-than-expected inference pattern during model tuning. They’re an early strategic prospect for our finance vertical integrations — their CTO is very technical and feeding us high-quality prompts that exercise quantization and LLM routing. They’re asking for a one-off uplift beyond PLG limits so they can complete a realistic production benchmark.

Current ask from Lena (procurement): 60,000 free inference credits and an additional 30-day pilot window (from 4/1 -> 5/1). They’ve committed to a technical review with our Applied ML team and expect to share a short report and a procurement PO by EOM if the benchmark looks good.

Why this matters:
- Upside: strong path to a dedicated contract (>$250k ARR in year 1) if benchmarks meet SLAs; referenceable customer for regulated finance use cases.
- Risk: credits exceed standard PLG guardrails (we typically cap at 25k for sandbox/pilot).

Requesting: executive one-off approval to grant 60k credits + 30-day extension. Suggested conditional terms: 1) require PO intent email from Procurement (procurement@silverpine.ai) within 14 days; 2) technical checkpoint with Marissa/Applied ML at day 15; 3) limit to model variants A/B only (no production routing to hosted endpoints).

Attachments: Silverpine_usage_snapshot_20280331.csv (sample usage), Silverpine_qualified_PO_template.pdf (procurement template).

Can you weigh in? Karthik — please confirm if Deal Desk needs to log a special approval code. Aditya — would you be comfortable with this commitment threshold if we build the conditional gates?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Lena — good news. Internal execs have conditionally approved a one-off uplift of 60,000 inference credits and a 30-day extension for your pilot. Please see the conditions below (they mirror what we discussed):

1) Procurement PO intent: please reply to this thread with an email from procurement@silverpine.ai confirming intent to issue a PO within 14 days.
2) Credits will be provisioned only to the pilot account listed in the attached template and will be locked to that account (no transfers).
3) Technical checkpoint: schedule a 45-minute review with Marissa and our Applied ML team on or around day 15 of the extension so we can validate benchmarks.
4) Legal will do a limited-scope review once PO intent arrives; the credits are contingent on Legal sign-off of the limited-scope clause.

If you can confirm PO intent today or tomorrow, we’ll begin provisioning the credits within 48 hours of receiving the procurement email (subject to Legal). We’ll also share a short finance memo for your records.

Appreciate the partnership — excited to see the results from your benchmark.

Best,
Hannah
